channel.name: mech
channel.purpose: Mechanical engineering: design, DFM, vendors, drawings

context: Ongoing: Vent path sizing and cell spacing to contain a single-cell runaway. This week: Idris: 2 mm cell spacing gives ~40 s before neighbor reaches 130 C in sims.
Ongoing: FOC rewrite with a thermal model and derating for DVT actuators. This week: Jonas starts FOC v2: 20 kHz current loop, thermal model from Nadia.
Ongoing: Tendons fray at the proximal pulley after 40k grip cycles. This week: Pulley groove re-cut with R0.3 edge and Delrin bushing; test restarted.
Ongoing: Type III anodize adds ~0.025 mm per surface and kills the bearing press fit. This week: Drawing note added: mask bearing bores, anodize after machining; reorder of the batch debated.
Ongoing: What to show investors when no full humanoid exists
Ongoing: Harness conductors breaking at the knee after ~15k flex cycles. This week: Farah: bend radius at the knee is 8 mm, cable rated for 7.5x OD dynamic, we are at 3x.
Ongoing: Gait controller tuning for the investor demo on the gait gantry. This week: Ten consecutive steps at 0.3 m/s; ankle oscillates at heel strike.
Ongoing: Gate driver ringing and current sense offset on the motor driver
Ongoing: Too many life tests for one grip fixture and one dyno. This week: Dmitri proposes a second grip fixture, ~$4k in machined parts.
Ongoing: Whether to machine pelvis plates from 7075 or wait for a casting
